outcomes.description: Outcomes contains one entry per skill considered for upgrade.

error.description: Error is a human-readable description of the failure, set only when Status is UpgradeStatusFailed.

new_digest.description:
NewDigest is the digest the source currently resolves to. It may equal
OldDigest when only the resolved reference or trust material changed.

new_resolved_reference.description: NewResolvedReference is the new resolvedReference when it changed.

new_signer_identity.description:
NewSignerIdentity is the candidate's signer identity when it differs
from the recorded one (empty when the candidate is unsigned).

old_digest.description: OldDigest is the digest pinned in the lock file before this operation.

reason.description: Reason is a typed failure reason when Status is UpgradeStatusFailed.
reason.title: github_com_stacklok_toolhive_pkg_skills.FailureReason

status.description: Status is the outcome of the upgrade attempt.
status.title: github_com_stacklok_toolhive_pkg_skills.UpgradeStatus

trust_anchor_changed.description:
TrustAnchorChanged reports that the operation selected a different
verified provenance or unsigned trust state than the lock recorded.

404.description: Not Found (a requested name is not in the lock file)
